question: What will the first reported earnings per share after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Nvidia)

calls.reasoning: Q2 FY27 GAAP EPS was $2.46 (non-GAAP $2.22, the gap being $7.8B of equity gains). Q3 guidance of $108B ±2% revenue, 74% GM and $9.2B GAAP opex implies ~$2.52 core EPS at guidance and ~$2.58 on a typical beat (Q2 beat its guide by ~5%); non-GAAP consensus is ~$2.47-2.53. GAAP also includes equity marks: from Jul 24 to Oct 23 SpaceX rose $115.07->$147.49 (+28%, ~+$5B on a ~$17-21B stake), Intel fell $92.32->$86.96 (~-$1.2B; its 29% crash on Oct 30 came after the quarter ended), and CoreWeave fell ~$80->$54 (~-$1B). That nets roughly +$0.09/share after tax. Private marks are unknown, and OpenAI's round had not closed. No human market found.
